interpretations.exact_text: In a scene similar to the former, a young man stands in the act of proclamation. He is unknown but faithful, and his tidings are strange.

interpretations.exact_text: Dark young man, faithful, a lover, an envoy, a postman. Beside a man, he will bear favourable testimony concerning him. A dangerous rival, if followed by the Page of Cups. Has the chief qualities of his suit. He may signify family intelligence.
interpretations.locator: Part III, §2, The Lesser Arcana, Suit of Wands, Page

interpretations.exact_text: Anecdotes, announcements, evil news. Also indecision and the instability which accompanies it.
